content: Yangonemoo Anatumi kinyi lalu lao leyamo renge keyange dupwa peparae namwa keta palamo. Dokona yulu mendeme namwana yongope imambupi karo pisinyi pyambungi doko rekya lao liti pimana. Yulu poo pyasi iki moko minyuo pyuo karo Anatu pako karo baa yeelyo poraiyuo suu pyao karamanale.
Namwa mata joo kara nalapape. Namwa mendali kando koo pii nao kokwa see nao minyoko pii nao pyuo karenge.
Nakama koo piyami lao lapusa pii nalyamo. Wambo langiyunuli pyuo dee kamba langilyu. Namwame nakama mona retenge dokome lete kararamanopape kumaramanopape nakama pipya role pyao kararama.
Nakama mondo lao pyuo karaminyi doko sepala rae maiyuo mona anda pyakalyuo pyao karo. Randa peparae nyimwanopape paka nao raeme kumuo karo.
Kinyi yuu Masetonia pao karapala dokopa koo soo kara nayama. Randa dupwa yuu muu dupwana soo kapa piya. Wambu menge dupwa kando laiya lao paka renge neta epo piya.
Paka renge neta epeyamopape Anatumi wambu mona nembenge dupwa mona minyarambu pingi doko baame Taitesa jepala namba mona porainyi pyambuya.

Baa epeyamo dokome iki namwa porainyi pyambwa naya. Nakamame banya mona porainyi pyambuyaminyi doko langiyamo sepala namwa rae maiyama. Nakama namba Pole kandamwali yaka letaminyi lao langiya. Langiyamopa nakama kondome kumapala nambana reke lao lakao karaminyi langiya. Dokona dakepa namba rae andake mailyu.
Pepa pyao jiyu dokome nakama mona kendanyi pyambuyamopape namba mende suu pyaa nayo. Angi kandeyoli dokopa kondayoliŋi dakepa konda nalyo.

Nakama mona kendanyi pyambuyu dokona lao rae mailyu laa nalyo. Nakama mona kendayami renge dokome suu pingi alowa piyami dokona lao dakepa namba rae mailyu. Nakamana mona kendo kareyami dokome Anatumi nakamana suu pingi alowa piya. Dokona lao namwa nakama randa julu joo jii nayama kande.
Namwa mona kendo kararama dokopa Anatu nyisaramopa mona kapu kyepala lete penge kata dokona rae maiyuo parama. Dopa piramanopape wambunya mona kendange renge dokome kumungi renge minyuo epenge.

Anatumi nakamana mona kendayami dokona nyepala apa piya lao kandalapape. Dakepa nakama mona angi palyuokondali pilyamo. Koo pii nalyamano lao poraiyuo simili yaka lao letaminyi. Nakama koo pilyaminyi larami ramo doko imbwuarami. Imbwuapala koo pilyaminyi laka nanale. Dake mupwa wakasa lao poraiyuo suu pyapala namba kando mona andake retelyaminyi. Wambu menge dupwa koo pirami ramo dokopa waiya lao pyalana letaminyi. Yulu dake piminyi dokome nakama kopetame pii nayami lao pano nolakaya.

Pepa jiyunu doko akali koo piyamo dokona reke lao pyaa nayo. Dee akali baa keta koo pyuo pisiyamo dokona lao pyaa nayoko. Nakama Anatunya lenge kambu dokona karo apa pyuo namwa mona retelyaminyi lao lasaka pelana pepa piyu.
Renge dokona namwa porainyi pyambulyamo. Renge mende palamo doko nakama peparaeme Taitesa baa rae mainyi pyambuyaminyisa baa rae maiyuo karamo doko kandapala rae mailyamano.

Namba wambo nakama yulu keyange pingi lao Taitesa lamaiyu. Nakama enakana namba elyanyi pyambwa nayami. Yuu peparae pii rolae angi lao langyuo kareyama doko suu pyao enakana nakama yulu keyange piyami Taitesa kandeya dokome namwa pii kinyi ingyuo peya.
Baa epeyamo dokopa nakama banya pii warombo sepala lakanda minya minya pyuo yako lao sukusa nyiyami doko suu pyaro karamo. Dopa pyuo piyamisa baa nakama angingyuo mona jilyamo.
Namba nakama arapu dokona renge renge soo karapunu dokona namba rae andake maiyuo karo.
